segments.name: exploration of seafloor polymetallic nodules
segments.description: Explores seafloor polymetallic nodules and develops a metallurgical process to treat them.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, the Company operates as a single operating and reportable segment, namely exploration of seafloor polymetallic nodules, which includes the development of a metallurgical process to treat such seafloor polymetallic nodules.
